architecture.mechanism: machine learning with state-of-the-art ML interpretability
architecture.intervention: Apply the Discovery Engine to analyze archived Honda CR-V sensor logs and dealer diagnostic codes to identify the specific latent variable correlation causing the no-start failure, replacing the need for whole engine replacement.
architecture.expected_effect: Identification of a repairable component or software fault rather than a catastrophic engine failure, restoring vehicle operation without full engine replacement.
architecture.falsification_test: Run the Discovery Engine on the specific ODI complaint dataset; if it fails to generate an interpretability artefact linking the warning light to a non-engine-failure cause within 24 hours, the mechanism is ineffective for this case.
